Theme

Time, the calendar & feasts

period noun

a length of time

also span of time, spell, era, age, space of time, class period, study period

classical

Cic. Arch. 1: spatium praeteritī temporis (Lewis & Short)
Caes. BG 6.18 (Lewis & Short)
Traupman 88, 359
Traupman 30: tertiō spatiō, in the third period (class period); spatium studiōsum, study period

spatium, spatiī n.

noun, second declension

a space of time, a period

Often with temporis. A school period is a spatium too: tertiō spatiō, in the third period (Traupman 359).

Other words

  • tempus, temporis n. — time; in the plural, the times, a period

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Cic. Fam. 2.18.3: tempora reī pūblicae

  • aetās, aetātis f. — a period of life; an age, an era

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Cic. Sen. 33: suaque cuique partī aetātis tempestīvitās est data; Traupman 77

Examples

  • ā sōle enim exortō ad exortum ejusdem incipientem tōtum id spatium ūnīus diēī nōmine appellāre

    (the Babylonians) call the whole period from one sunrise to the next by the name of one dayGell. 3.2.5

  • spatium studiōsum

    a study periodTraupman 387

  • tertiō spatiō

    in the third periodTraupman 359

See also hour, future, history.
